items.text: The New "Heavy Defense" DLC and the Update 1.4.0 are available now on PC, PlayStation 5 & XBOX Series X|S!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41120541/eebc59c230048a70406fd8b13796fba676d26244.png"]
HEAVY DEFENSE: Heavily loaded in camouflage. 🚛

Heavy haulage. Military vehicles. Demanding missions. 💪 Take on exciting new heavy haulage jobs, transport impressive military vehicles and get your cargo safely to its destination using, amongst other things, a new special trailer for tanks.
From the barracks to the military port, via the military training area to the next delivery location – every mission presents you with new challenges.
Make your fleet stand out and give your truckers their own unique camouflage patterns – customise your heavy-duty fleet to suit your personal style. 🎨
The next mission awaits – are you ready?

notes.title: Here’s what’s in store for you

items.text: 🎯 10 new heavy-haul missions
🚛 10 new loads – military vehicles inspired by various NATO countries
🌟 1 new special trailer for transporting tanks
🏕️ 3 new delivery locations – barracks, military port & military training area
🎨 11 new paint jobs with various camouflage patterns
[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/Ev1Yugl6JzY?si=0n8D6fty5Gt3EDLh"]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/5100210/Heavy_Cargo_The_Truck_Simulator_Heavy_Defense/"]

The new update brings a whole host of improvements and new features to the game. From now on, you can customise the paintwork on your trucks’ bumpers, lamp brackets, wheel rims and horns, allowing you to personalise your fleet even further. 🎨✨

It’s now also possible to enable or disable the time rating for missions. This means you can take your time and drive your route without any time pressure – even longer stops at traffic lights are no longer a problem. ⏱️🚦😎
The lighting and weather effects have also been improved, creating a more atmospheric and realistic ambience during your journeys. 🌦️💡

Furthermore, the gear-changing behaviour of the trucks on hills has been optimised, meaning that the gearbox no longer downshifts prematurely when driving uphill if the engine speed falls below a certain threshold, whilst the engine speed continues to rise steadily. This helps to maintain the higher gear already selected and stabilises the driving behaviour. 🚛⛰️🔽⚙️
Furthermore, additional bugs relating to missions, navigation and vehicle spawning have been fixed to make the heavy load transport experience even smoother. 🚛⚙️
The update is rounded off by various gameplay improvements and numerous bug fixes.
Hier findet Ihr die kompletten Patchnotes: https://heavy-cargo.aerosoft.com/patches

The New "Heavy South" DLC and the Massive Update 1.3.0 are available now on PC, PlayStation 5 & XBOX Series X|S!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41120541/12c149bf7bdd242b4cbf9dfddd3edd117f43106c.png"]
HEAVY SOUTH: New challenges for the south - hauling heavy cargo through the mountains! 🚛🏔️
The "Heavy South" DLC is here! It brings an extensive expansion of the map to the south, doubling the size of the game world.
Additionally, you can look forward to 31 exciting new heavy and super heavy missions, along with new delivery locations, cargo types, trailers, and a brand-new route mission.
Master the wide variety of new missions, enjoy the breathtaking mountain atmosphere, and take on new challenges in heavy and super-heavy transport.

With Update 1.3.0, the long-awaited activatable virtual right-side mirror requested by the community is being added to the game. This means you won’t miss potential obstacles on the right side anymore, helping you achieve even better evaluations.
We have extensively reworked the game world, focusing on vegetation and detail to create more realistic landscapes and an even more immersive atmosphere.
All trucks now feature a top-down camera, providing a better overview and making manoeuvring easier. Optimized loading and reloading of the game world also ensures shorter loading times.
The trucks have also received improved gear-shifting behavior, resulting in more efficient and realistic driving.

For a more immersive gaming experience, haptic feedback has been enhanced. The optimized controller vibration and refined steering wheel force feedback provide a much more realistic response when driving over curbs or colliding with obstacles.
For breathtaking screenshots, we’ve significantly increased the draw distance both in-game and in photo mode (16 km!).
In addition, you can expect various gameplay improvements and several bug fixes that further enhance the overall gameplay experience.
You can find the full patch notes here 👉 https://heavy-cargo.aerosoft.com/patches

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41120541/bb2cdb43481d2428fd457326a31f7ad6b0f55fe9.png"]
Hello truckers!
We are pleased to finally be able to provide you with the ON THE ROAD - The Truck Simulator GRAPHICS UPDATE for PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
This update includes a variety of visual improvements, overhauled buildings and improved times of day and weather effects.

This makes everything much more atmospheric and immersive. We have also increased the draw distance and the number of available save slots on PS5 and Xbox Series S|X. You now have 3 save slots available. If you like the update, please leave a positive review. Thank you and have a safe journey.
[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Np0n-KCAv4E"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41120541/276a5e8b38b9085acbaba858787f2165df2ce644.png"]
Dear Community,
On August 4, 2025, the time has come: The free “Mission Pack” DLC and Update 1.1.0 will be released for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

With this update, you can look forward to ten additional missions with new cargo types, a brand-new delivery location, and – as a special highlight for console players – force feedback support for steering wheels.
As always, you can find all the details in the patch notes. The full changelog is already available here: https://heavy-cargo.aerosoft.com/patches/
We wish you lots of fun with the new missions – and safe travels!
Hello truckers!
We are pleased to be able to provide you with Update 1.0.4.

In addition to a large number of corrections, optimisations and improvements, we were also able to implement a whole host of requests from you. To the delight of our Japanese and Brazilian communities, these languages have now also found their way into the game. For more immersion when driving, the controller now vibrates when there are hard bumps, such as kerbs. In addition, our favourite, the MAN TGE, affectionately known as the Plötze, has been given a few updates. Various materials in the interior have been corrected and the cruise control now also works at speeds above 80 km/h. In addition, the instrument cluster now displays all symbol lights correctly. If you don't save manually, we have reduced the autosave interval from 10 minutes to 2 minutes. This means you don't have to drive or play a large part of the route again.
A detailed list of all changes can be found here: https://heavy-cargo.aerosoft.com/patches/
Thank you for your reports and feedback. Thank you for your reports and your numerous feedback. If you like the update, please leave a positive review.
Hello truckers!
We are pleased to release Update 1.0.3.
In addition to a large number of corrections and improvements, especially in the areas of UI and sound, we were also able to implement a whole host of requests from you.

One of the many highlights is the greatly revised steering with controller, whereby the input of the stick no longer controls the steering speed, but the steering angle, which enables much more precise driving with controller.

We have also made a change to the unlocking of add-on parts, which now makes it easier to unlock the same add-on parts for different cabins. We have also made a change to the unlocking of add-on parts, which now makes it easier to unlock the same add-on parts for different cabins. Optimising the path calculation was also on our to-do list, resulting in a better working navigation system.

If you ever lose your bearings with your avatar, a new compass at the top of the screen will help you find the most important spots in your neighbourhood. Another item on our list was the dollies for wind wing transports, which now behave more comprehensibly. So that you can enjoy the changes a little more relaxed, the traffic light flashers are now much more accommodating.
If you are still not satisfied with the results in your saves, you can now delete them in the corresponding menus and no longer just overwrite them.
A detailed list of all changes can be found here: https://heavy-cargo.aerosoft.com/patches/

Important information for console players: Your buttonbindings will be reset with the update to avoid subsequent errors in the game. So if you have assigned your buttons according to your preferences, you will have to repeat this once again.
Thank you for your reports and feedback. Thank you for your reports and your numerous feedback. If you like the update, please leave a positive review.
Hello truckers!

With Update 1.0.2, we are delivering a large number of changes and corrections in the most frequently requested areas of Heavy Cargo.In addition to a much more direct steering of the trucks, the Steam version now also includes force feedback for a large number of different steering wheels so that you can enjoy the changed driving behaviour to the full. To ensure that you are not only travelling between first and second gear on the mountain, we have taken another close look at the gearbox control and adjusted and tidied up countless areas. In the course of this, further changes were also made to the vehicle functions. You can now enjoy all of this in better, dynamically changing weather between missions. The missions themselves have undergone countless corrections and fine-tuning in various places. AI traffic has also received a number of functional optimisations, especially at junctions. 1.0.2 is rounded off with a large number of new features and corrections in the UI / UX area with a focus on the map menu, as well as a series of bug fixes and minor improvements in various areas. To make sure your ears don't miss out either, a large part of the sounds have been revised and the soundtrack has been completely replaced. Copyright takedowns on YouTube are now a thing of the past. You can find a detailed list of all the changes below.
Thank you for your reports and your numerous feedback. If you like the update, please leave a positive review.
Patch Notes
Highlights
Force feedback and improved support for additional steering wheels
Significantly more direct truck steering
Major improvements to drivetrain control and various vehicle systems
Probability of bad weather between missions drastically reduced, dynamic weather changes introduced.
Improvements
Gameplay and missions
Unnecessary impact wrench removed in Preptask during ‘Energy transition’ mission
Various AI improvements integrated, especially at junctions without a left-turn lane and/or without traffic lights
The mobile crane now also has an automatic set-up function like the XS crane.
Various improvements to the mission ‘The last voyage’
Input devices
Force feedback and improved support for additional steering wheels
Vehicles
Significantly more direct truck steering
Major improvements to drivetrain control
Cruise control stays on when accelerating, then the speed drops back to the set speed
Positioning of the rear wind turbine adapter improved
Improved height adjustment of modular heavy-duty trailers
Various vehicle-related optimisations
The total mileage of the vehicles is now saved, while the trip odometer is set to 0 after each savegame load.
UI / UX
UI buttons now have a visual distinction between the selected option and selection, which has fixed a number of bugs and inconsistencies.
A confirmation prompt now appears when overwriting memory states
The terms autosave, quicksave and manual save are now translated
Retarder is correctly displayed with D Pad Left Hold
Radio station display is only shown briefly when a new track is added or a station is changed so that the mirror is no longer obscured
Better visual demarcation of the photo spot to the triggers for running in (further improvements in progress)
In-game key mapping overlay is now more context sensitive when travelling with the van
Map view now jumps to the player's position when first opened and no longer preselects the first mission and then jumps to it
Map menu now shows close map instead of just map to make the function a little clearer
Map menu now shows a legend of the most important information
Garage clearly named in map menu
Reference to newly available add-on parts and chassis in mission completion screen clarified
The total number of destroyed obstacles is now displayed in the mission evaluation if this exceeds the maximum number of permitted obstacles.
Help texts with detailed descriptions of the individual functions have been added to the options menus
Icons in the settings menu are drawn equally sharp in different resolutions
Feedback form improved and expanded
Improved visual button feedback when hovering with the mouse but not clicking
Sound
Various sounds and all songs replaced with new versions. Copyright takedowns for streams and videos are now excluded
The reversing alarm and horn are now much more audible in the cockpit
Gameworld
Probability of bad weather between missions drastically reduced, dynamic weather changes introduced.
Improved visuals and performance, as well as correct direction of rotation of the wind turbines in the game world
Billboard and lit barrel pillars Advertising updated
Other
Various logs that are no longer required have been removed, resulting in a slight improvement in performance
Bug fixes
Unlocked missions are correctly displayed as unlocked in the mission list immediately after unlocking
AI vehicles no longer block each other at junctions
Fixed orbit camera clipping, shaking or jumping between load and trailer in various missions
Fixed missing collision of the rear trailer part in mission ‘The last voyage’
Fixed faulty collisions that caused the boat to jump in the mission ‘The last crossing’ during the crane operation
Fixed faulty trigger for red light offences at an intersection
UI of the XS crane now shows correct terms for extending and retracting the supports
It is no longer possible to knock over the crane with the avatar
Resetting a route preparation while the camera is focussed, e.g. unscrewing crash barriers, no longer causes the camera system to crash
Fixed sporadically faulty/non-existent collisions of various level objects
Flickering decal at the start of the ‘’custom-made‘’ mission corrected
Fixed another memory leak which could cause blurred textures and/or crashes after a longer playing time
As expected, the steering menu can now also be navigated using the steering wheel and controller
Indicator relay is now played in the interior if you have previously activated indicators in orbit, bumper or over-cab view.
After fast travelling twice to the same fast travel point, you are no longer catapulted into the air
Cruise control no longer remains active when the handbrake is applied and works again after exiting and re-entering the vehicle
The reversing warning tone is no longer deactivated when the vehicle brakes to a standstill in reverse gear
Camera is directly in place when the XS crane is activated and no longer performs a tracking shot
It is no longer possible to board while the tool is moving away animation is running
The load on the crane no longer remains physically frozen when you leave the crane and re-enter it
Radio does not continue playing at the position of vehicles that are no longer present
Photo spot from tutorial is no longer visible in the missions if the tutorial has not been played
Positioning of rotating beacons on trailers with PPU, for example, corrected in the tutorial
Bug that could lead to the driving style analysis not being executed properly fixed
Engine speed now correctly returns to idle when you get off at full throttle when stationary
Traffic vehicles no longer appear on the closed-off routes of various missions.
Fixed jumping traffic cone near the preparation task in Mission Zigzagging through the city
Gas tanker in Velslow harbour is now loaded on time and no longer pops up visibly
parked vehicles are no longer stuck in the ground in the car park east of Lütt Jussen
XS crane no longer rotates the base in hook / second arm mode when no load is picked up and thus follows the behaviour of the mobile crane more consistently
Fixed a timing issue in the camera section of the tutorial.
Bug that could lead to the trophy ‘I can drive anything’ not triggering has been fixed.
Remains of old level development in the harbour area of Velslow removed
Ramps of the city exits in Velslow revised so that a crossing in the mission ‘With extra width to the quarry’ is possible without any problems.
Navi route is now updated correctly in various missions
Timing problem which could lead to temporary unresolvable spots has been fixed.
Fixed an issue where the character selection was not displayed clearly and synchronised between character and UI
Fixed a bug that could cause the total distance of a mission to display completely utopian values.
Selection of fast travel point as destination no longer closes the mission selection, making the behaviour inconsistent.
Various errors in the mission selection via controller have been fixed, making it much easier to use.
Playing the tutorial no longer remains highlighted if you have already switched to name input

Mission ‘’Custom made‘’ unlocks the wheels to the correct extent without the need to complete it several times

Have a safe ride!
